{{TOC|side}}
Most [[:Category:Arma 3 DLCs &amp; Expansions|Arma 3 DLCs &amp; Expansions]] come with restrictions regarding the usage of their premium assets (e.g. vehicles and weapons).
This technology is referred to as [[Arma 3: DLC Content Licensing|Content Licensing]].
Some DLC assets are ''not'' covered by this limitation and are added to the base game / platform for free (e.g. decorative props).

{{Feature|informative|
* All (premium) DLC assets can be tested without any kind of limitation or ads in the [[Arma 3: Arsenal|Arsenal]].
* As the in-game ads will tell, press {{Controls|LShift|P}} in order to open the DLC Content Browser menu.
* See the {{Link|https://www.bohemia.net/blog/roadmap-14-15-dlc-strategy-blog|Roadmap 2014/15 - Arma 3 DLC Strategy}} blog post for further information.
}}

{{Feature|informative|
{{Icon|arma3spex|25}} For the restrictions of the [[Spearhead 1944]] CDLC and its companion modification [[:Category: SPEX - Spearhead Extended|SPEX - Spearhead Extended]] visit [[Spearhead Extended Asset Restrictions]].
}}


== Different Restrictions ==

The following restrictions only apply to '''[[#Per Item DLC Restrictions|DLC assets]]''' that have '''DLC Restrictions''' applied to them.
A more technical description of said restrictions and how to configure Content Licensing for DLC can be viewed on the [[Arma 3: DLC Content Licensing]] page.
<!--
{{Feature|informative|
Take a look at the {{Link|https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/store/application/dlc#7|Steam Downloadable Content (DLC) Test chapter}}
to temporarily disable DLC ownership and test user-created content that contains DLC assets.
}}
-->

=== Weapon Restrictions ===

* Cannot be picked up from a box, a corpse, or anywhere else.
* If added by script or already provided, the DLC ads overlay will appear more and more frequently.

=== Vehicle Restrictions ===

* Cannot get in the Driver, Commander and Gunner positions. Passenger seats including FFV seats are still open to non-owners.
** Even though Passenger seats are open to everyone, ads will still appear for non-owners.
* If put in Driver, Commander and Gunner seats by script/already there as mission starts, the DLC ads overlay will appear more and more frequently.

=== Gear Restrictions ===

* Cannot be picked up from a box, a corpse, or anywhere else.
* If added by script or already provided, the DLC ads overlay will appear more and more frequently.

=== Drone Restrictions ===

Cannot be connected to via the UAV Terminal.

=== Terrain Restrictions ===

The terrain simply cannot be accessed (even in [[:Category:Eden Editor|Eden Editor]]).

=== Mission Restrictions ===

If the mission is DLC-restricted, the mission cannot be started (such as some official Showcases and Challenges).
* In [[Eden Editor: Scenario Attributes|Eden Editor]], restrictions are set via '''Attributes > General > Overview > DLC''' and '''Require DLC''' if necessary.

=== Props Restrictions ===

There's nothing unless the DLC is an optional DLC. Every prop that included in the vanilla game is free to use, without any kind of restrictions.


== Per Item DLC Restrictions ==

Since a displayed DLC icon doesn't mean the item is restricted (premium), the following tables help finding out which items and equipment mission makers can use.

{{Feature|informative|
* These tables are valid as of {{arma3}} '''v2.10'''.
* '''[[#Personal Equipment|Personal Equipment]]''' list icons are based on [[Arsenal]].
* '''[[#Vehicles|Vehicles]]''' list icons are based on [[Eden Editor: Asset Browser| Eden Editor's Asset Browser]].
}}
